## Receipt change

Describe the numbers, counts, and receipt dates being added or corrected.

- [ ] I edited `data/receipts.csv` and kept the header.
- [ ] Counts represent actual receipts, not the last digits of a total or a price.
- [ ] I checked for accidental duplicate rows; repeat rows add extra copies.
- [ ] Unknown receipt dates are blank, not guessed.
- [ ] `npm run validate:receipts` succeeds.
- [ ] No personal links, names, payment details, receipt images, or database files are included.
